# TEAM CODE (owner: Tom - sound output and effects) - written by the BJT2 team, not generated by STM32CubeMX.
# Authors: Tom; Brendon (integrator) added the TunePlayer lines (28 Oct 2026) and the output-chain lines (RateAdapter, FxRender, Crossover, test_output_chain; 29-30 Oct 2026, with an AI coding assistant), and test_fx_resume (30 Oct 2026, with an AI coding assistant).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.23)
project(PD5AudioEffects LANGUAGES C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)

include(CTest)
option(ENABLE_COVERAGE "Enable LLVM source coverage instrumentation" OFF)

function(pd5_enable_warnings target)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE /W4)
    else()
        target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE
            -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wshadow
        )
    endif()
endfunction()

function(pd5_enable_coverage target)
    if(NOT ENABLE_COVERAGE)
        return()
    endif()

    if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
        target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE
            -fprofile-instr-generate
            -fcoverage-mapping
        )
        target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE
            -fprofile-instr-generate
            -fcoverage-mapping
        )
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "ENABLE_COVERAGE requires Clang/AppleClang. Use the coverage-macos preset on macOS.")
    endif()
endfunction()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Production, hardware-independent application code
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_library(application STATIC
    Application/AudioEffects/audio_effects.c
    Application/AudioEffects/pitch_detector.c
    Application/AudioEffects/pitch_shifter.c
    Application/ResearchAutotune/td_psola_autotune.c
    Application/TunePlayer/tune_player.c
    Application/RateAdapter/rate_adapter.c
    Application/FxRender/fx_render.c
    Application/Crossover/crossover.c
)
target_include_directories(application PUBLIC
    Application/AudioEffects
    Application/ResearchAutotune
    Application/TunePlayer
    Application/RateAdapter
    Application/FxRender
    Application/Crossover
)
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_link_libraries(application PUBLIC m)
endif()
pd5_enable_warnings(application)
pd5_enable_coverage(application)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Unity test framework (course-provided core + local fixture compatibility)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_library(unity STATIC
    Tests/Unity/unity.c
    Tests/Unity/unity_fixture.c
)
target_include_directories(unity PUBLIC Tests/Unity)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Behavioural DSP unit tests
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(test_audio_effects
    Tests/AudioEffects/test_main.c
    Tests/AudioEffects/test_audio_effects.c
    Tests/AudioEffects/test_pitch_detector.c
    Tests/AudioEffects/test_pitch_shifter.c
)
target_link_libraries(test_audio_effects PRIVATE application unity)
pd5_enable_warnings(test_audio_effects)
pd5_enable_coverage(test_audio_effects)
add_test(NAME audio_effects_behaviour COMMAND test_audio_effects)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Research autotune comparison tests (TD-PSOLA, host/offline prototype)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(test_td_psola_autotune
    Tests/ResearchAutotune/test_td_psola_autotune.c
)
target_link_libraries(test_td_psola_autotune PRIVATE application unity)
pd5_enable_warnings(test_td_psola_autotune)
pd5_enable_coverage(test_td_psola_autotune)
add_test(NAME td_psola_autotune_research COMMAND test_td_psola_autotune)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tune player tests (startup sound + warning tunes rendered by TomTask)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(test_tune_player
    Tests/TunePlayer/test_tune_player.c
)
target_link_libraries(test_tune_player PRIVATE application unity)
pd5_enable_warnings(test_tune_player)
pd5_enable_coverage(test_tune_player)
add_test(NAME tune_player COMMAND test_tune_player)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Output-chain tests: the 2:3 rate adapter, the effect-file renderer (checked
# sample for sample against a copy of the old live chain) and the speaker
# crossover. These three modules are deliberately NOT in the orchestration
# target below, which compiles audio_effects.c against mocks only.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(test_output_chain
    Tests/OutputChain/test_output_chain.c
    Tests/OutputChain/test_rate_adapter.c
    Tests/OutputChain/test_fx_render.c
    Tests/OutputChain/test_fx_resume.c
    Tests/OutputChain/test_crossover.c
    Tests/OutputChain/live_chain_oracle.c
)
target_link_libraries(test_output_chain PRIVATE application unity)
pd5_enable_warnings(test_output_chain)
pd5_enable_coverage(test_output_chain)
add_test(NAME output_chain COMMAND test_output_chain)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test-double target: compile the high-level AudioEffects module against
# hand-written PitchDetector/PitchShifter mocks instead of the real modules.
# This verifies dependency interactions and error propagation independently.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_library(audio_effects_orchestration STATIC
    Application/AudioEffects/audio_effects.c
)
target_include_directories(audio_effects_orchestration PUBLIC
    Application/AudioEffects
)
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_link_libraries(audio_effects_orchestration PUBLIC m)
endif()
pd5_enable_warnings(audio_effects_orchestration)
pd5_enable_coverage(audio_effects_orchestration)

add_executable(test_audio_effects_orchestration
    Tests/Mocks/test_mock_main.c
    Tests/Mocks/test_audio_effects_orchestration.c
    Tests/Mocks/mock_dsp_dependencies.c
)
target_include_directories(test_audio_effects_orchestration PRIVATE
    Tests/Mocks
    Application/AudioEffects
)
target_link_libraries(test_audio_effects_orchestration PRIVATE
    audio_effects_orchestration
    unity
)
pd5_enable_warnings(test_audio_effects_orchestration)
pd5_enable_coverage(test_audio_effects_orchestration)
add_test(NAME audio_effects_orchestration COMMAND test_audio_effects_orchestration)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Audible host-side demo utility (not part of the embedded firmware)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(audio_effect_demo Tools/audio_effect_demo.c)
target_link_libraries(audio_effect_demo PRIVATE application)
pd5_enable_warnings(audio_effect_demo)
